character.name: Kairo "Kai" Baptiste
character.role: Main hero / first Opaija Seed wielder

styleLock.summary: Dark cinematic 2D Trini anime with orange/gold rhythm energy, sharp linework, full weapon readability, Afro-Caribbean costume detail.
required: Use Kairo "Kai" Baptiste's approved model sheet only.
Keep The Listening Bois visible in power and combat frames.
Use full-body or three-quarter action framing when the weapon is active.
Use gold/orange rhythm lightning, black ink shadows, and Trinidad street/gayelle energy.
forbidden: Do not convert the model sheet into a grid, turnaround, collage, label sheet, or multiple-pose reference page.
Do not change age, face shape, nose structure, skin tone, hair, core outfit, weapon, or power identity.
Do not add subtitles, watermark text, logos, random crowds, extra limbs, broken hands, or melted weapon geometry.

audioActionRules.voiceStyle: Action-first VO: 2-3 short lines only. SFX and music carry the fight rhythm.
audioActionRules.rule: Voice lines must land before the action they set up or after the impact they reveal; never run as generic narration across unrelated motion.

voiceLines: Trinidad does not wait for permission.
Kai Baptiste heard the first pulse.
But silence was already hunting him.

beats.label: Hook Hit
beats.visualAction: Kai drops into a low landing; orange rhythm cracks outward before he speaks.
beats.cameraMove: Fast vertical push-in from cracked ground to Kai's eyes.
beats.impactFrame: Ground pulse explodes under Kai's sneaker, dust and orange lightning frozen for one frame.
beats.sfx: Ground crack, low drum boom, breath catch.
beats.musicHit: Single tassa/808 hybrid hit on landing.
beats.voiceLine: Trinidad does not wait for permission.

beats.musicHit: Three drum hits synced to spin, plant, pulse.
